content: The interaction of dronabinol with other drugs is complex and requires careful monitoring due to its metabolism through hepatic enzymes, particularly CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, and its high plasma protein binding. 1. Dronabinol and Narrow Therapeutic Index Drugs: Dronabinol is highly bound to plasma proteins and may displace other highly protein-bound drugs, increasing their free fraction and potential toxicity. This effect has not been confirmed in vivo, but caution is advised when initiating or increasing the dose of dronabinol in patients taking narrow therapeutic index drugs. 2. Dronabinol and Voriconazole: Voriconazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 3. Dronabinol and Acetazolamide: Acetazolamide may increase dronabinol levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown, but monitoring is recommended. 4. Dronabinol and Anastrozole: Anastrozole may increase dronabinol levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance is unclear, but monitoring is advised. 5. Dronabinol and Cyclophosphamide: Cyclophosphamide may increase dronabinol levels through CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical impact is unknown, but monitoring is suggested. 6. Dronabinol and Drospirenone: Drospirenone may increase dronabinol levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The significance is unclear, but monitoring is recommended. 7. Dronabinol and Larotrectinib: Larotrectinib may increase dronabinol levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is unknown, but monitoring is advised. 8. Dronabinol and Alpelisib: Alpelisib decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 9. Dronabinol and Amiodarone: Amiodarone increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 10. Dronabinol and Amobarbital: Amobarbital increases dronabinol levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Dronabinol and Amphotericin B: Dronabinol increases amphotericin B levels by competing for plasma protein binding. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 12. Dronabinol and Apalutamide: Apalutamide decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs when possible. 13. Dronabinol and Atazanavir: Atazanavir increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Dronabinol and Belzutifan: Belzutifan decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. 15. Dronabinol and Bosentan: Bosentan decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Dronabinol and Butabarbital: Butabarbital decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 17. Dronabinol and Cannabidiol: Cannabidiol increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Consider dose reduction and monitor closely. 18. Dronabinol and Capecitabine: Capecitabine increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Dronabinol and Carbamazepine: Carbamazepine decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. Dronabinol and Cefotetan: Cefotetan increases dronabinol toxicity by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. Discontinue cefotetan at least 14 days before starting dronabinol. 21. Dronabinol and Cenobamate: Cenobamate decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the dose of dronabinol as needed and monitor closely. 22. Dronabinol and Ceritinib: Ceritinib increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Dronabinol and Clarithromycin: Clarithromycin increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Dronabinol and Clobazam: Co-administration may increase sedation or respiratory depression. Use caution and monitor closely. 25. Dronabinol and Clonidine: Clonidine increases dronabinol toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergy. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Dronabinol and Cobicistat: Cobicistat increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 27. Dronabinol and Conivaptan: Conivaptan increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Dronabinol and Disulfiram: Disulfiram increases dronabinol toxicity by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. Discontinue disulfiram at least 14 days before starting dronabinol. 29. Dronabinol and Efavirenz: Efavirenz increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 30. Dronabinol and Elagolix: Elagolix decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 31. Dronabinol and Fluconazole: Fluconazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Dronabinol and Grapefruit: Grapefruit increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Dronabinol and Ibuprofen: Ibuprofen increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 34. Dronabinol and Ketoconazole: Ketoconazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 35. Dronabinol and Metronidazole: Metronidazole increases dronabinol toxicity by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase. Discontinue metronidazole at least 14 days before starting dronabinol. 36. Dronabinol and Phenytoin: Phenytoin decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Dronabinol may also increase phenytoin levels by competing for plasma protein binding. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 37. Dronabinol and Rifampin: Rifampin decreases dronabinol levels by inducing CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 38. Dronabinol and Ritonavir: Ritonavir increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Dronabinol and Sirolimus: Dronabinol increases sirolimus levels by competing for plasma protein binding. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 40. Dronabinol and Voriconazole: Voriconazole increases dronabinol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. These interactions highlight the importance of monitoring and adjusting therapy when dronabinol is co-administered with other medications.
